resources.string: To provide the best experience like receiving calls and messages reliably, the app requires basic permissions (Camera, Microphone, Notifications) and advanced permissions (Display over Apps, Disable Battery Optimization) to be granted.
App notifications and calls may not work properly without these permissions. You can further allow them in Settings.
Please ensure all notification options like \"Lock screen\", \"Allow badges\", and \"Pop on screen\" are enabled for the best experience.
